examples.translation: You do not know what it means to live in the provinces... My parents lived like in the nineteenth century. Aunts, uncles, brothers, sisters, cousins, grandparents — and all Yids. No one goes to the synagogue, no one even speaks Yiddish, but everyone is always discussing how much Jewish blood so-and-so has.
